versions.changelog:
- Initial release of personal-info-protection-guard.
- Provides real-time compliance checks for privacy policy, user agreements, App permissions, data collection, marketing content, and more.
- Detects violations of laws and standards including PIPL, Data Security Law, Cybersecurity Law, and GB/T 35273.
- Blocks non-compliant items and offers modification suggestions.
- Supports structured compliance review reports.
